svg.title: Returns, Credit Memos and Refunds — BPMN teaching model
svg.desc: BPMN collaboration between a customer and Warehouse, Customer Accounting, and Treasury. A return leads to credit allocation against open AR with any excess retained as customer credit. Remaining customer credit can stay open or proceed to a recorded cash refund.
